description: This Java class defines enumerations and utility methods for various charge-related types within the Fineract project, such as charge time types, application targets, calculation types, payment modes, and fee frequencies. It provides methods to convert integer IDs or domain enumeration values into standardized EnumOptionData objects with descriptive labels, facilitating consistent representation and interpretation of charge attributes across the application.

classes.name: ChargeEnumerations
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for converting charge-related enumeration values and IDs into EnumOptionData objects for consistent representation.

methods.name: chargeTimeType(int)
methods.description: Converts an integer ID to an EnumOptionData for charge time type.

methods.name: chargeTimeType(ChargeTimeType)
methods.description: Converts a ChargeTimeType enum to an EnumOptionData with descriptive label.

methods.description: Converts an integer ID to an EnumOptionData for what the charge applies to.
